title: A unified framework of energy-stable splitting exponential integrators for damped Hamiltonian systems
summary: In this work, we study long-time numerical integration of Hamiltonian systems subject to linear perturbations. We assume the energy-compatible linear-damping condition, which ensures that the physical energy is nonincreasing along the linear damping subflow.
